oto.sektor: Bursa'da bir inşaat şantiyesi, iskeleler ve beton mikseri
oto.esnaf_tarif: sturdy Turkish construction foreman in his 50s, yellow hard hat, orange high-visibility vest over a checkered shirt, thick black mustache, pencil behind his ear
oto.fikir: Levent inşaatta 'bir günlük ustalık' denemek ister. Usta Kemal 'hemen biter' der; Türk inşaatlarındaki meşhur 'yarın bitiyor' esprisi. Punchline: Cemo bir tuğla koyup 'mesai bitti' diye çay molasına çıkar, usta onu kendi gibi bulur.
oto.notlar: Bu skeçte sponsor/reklam yok; sadece temiz mizah.

senaryo.aciklama: Türkiye'de her inşaat 'yarın' biter 😂 Sizin mahalledeki ne zaman bitiyor?

planlar.metin: [excited] Usta, bu bina ne zaman biter?
planlar.gorsel: A busy construction site in Bursa with scaffolding and an unfinished concrete building, Levent holding his microphone, the foreman seen from behind.
Same construction site, the foreman standing proudly in front of the unfinished building, Levent seen from behind.

planlar.metin: Usta, geçen yıl gelmiştim, yine yarın demiştiniz!
planlar.gorsel: Same construction site, Levent raising an eyebrow, the foreman seen from behind.

planlar.metin: Doğru... o başka yarındı, bu başka yarın.
planlar.gorsel: Same construction site, the foreman raising a finger like a philosopher, Levent seen from behind.
Same construction site, Cemo placing a single brick on a low unfinished brick wall.
planlar.hareket: Cemo places one single brick, wipes his forehead as if exhausted, then sits down on a bucket with a glass of tea
planlar.efekt: a brick is placed on mortar, then a tea spoon clinks in a tea glass

planlar.metin: [sighs] Usta, ben de yarın devam ederim.
planlar.gorsel: Same construction site, Cemo sitting on an upside-down bucket sipping a tulip-shaped Turkish tea glass, the foreman seen from behind.
